rows.ARS:
Red blend Floribunda.
Registration name: AROcruby
rows.Origin: Bred by Jack E. Christensen (United States, 1987).
rows.Bloom: Red blend. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 6,823 on 30 May 1989 VIEW USPTO PATENT
This invention relates to a new and distinct variety of floribunda rose

plant cv. Arocruby, particularly suited for garden decoration, identified

by its white flowers which develop an intense red blush on those areas of

the petals exposed to sunlight.
